title: Envelope
description: The frame around every twin/v1 message, in both directions. A frame is one JSON text of at most 65536 UTF-8 bytes. A receiver ignores fields it does not recognise.

v.description: The protocol major version. Always 1 in twin/v1.

type.description: The message type. message.schema.json lists the known types.

id.description: A unique ID of this frame, chosen by its sender.

ts.description: The time the sender made the frame, RFC 3339 in UTC.

runId.description: The run this frame belongs to. Required on every run.*, tool.* and events.ack message. Idempotent: a controller that resends run.start uses the same runId.

seq.description: The per-run sequence number of a run.event or run.end frame. Starts at 1 and grows by 1.

payload.description: The body of the message. Its shape depends on type.

twinId.description: A twin ID: lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'.

callId.description: The ID of one tool call inside a run.

configHash.description: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the canonical JSON of all resolved param values. Tool modes are not in it.

toolMode.description: real runs the production execute. fake returns a supplied value. confirm pauses for a reviewer decision.

fakeSource.description: Where a fake value came from: pinned by the reviewer, recorded from a matching call, or generated.
